memory_types.name: Short-term conversation history
memory_types.lifetime: Active conversation session (bounded to last 12-20 turns)
memory_types.retention: FIFO sliding window; oldest turns pruned when budget exceeded
memory_types.deletion: User clears chat or creates new session
memory_types.retrieval_policy: Injected only as dialogue turns for conversational coherence

memory_types.name: Session memory
memory_types.storage: SQLite memories table with session_id column
memory_types.lifetime: Bound strictly to the specific session_id
memory_types.retention: Persisted while session exists; marked historical on key update
memory_types.deletion: Session purge or explicit user memory delete command
memory_types.retrieval_policy: Filtered strictly by session_id; invisible to foreign sessions

memory_types.name: Persistent user memory
memory_types.storage: SQLite memories table (Tier 4 Preference & Tier 5 Semantic)
memory_types.lifetime: Permanent across application restarts until deleted by user
memory_types.retention: Active with incremented versioning; never auto-purged
memory_types.deletion: Explicit user command / UI memory manager; verified absence
memory_types.retrieval_policy: Main Model invokes memory tool; returned as untrusted data block

memory_types.name: Knowledge-base documents
memory_types.storage: SQLite document_chunks table with content_hash and doc_hash
memory_types.lifetime: Indexed file lifetime; updated upon source modification
memory_types.retention: Versioned upon file change; duplicate ingestion avoided via SHA256
memory_types.deletion: Document removal command; full chunk readback absence check
memory_types.retrieval_policy: Model explicitly queries via query_knowledge_base tool

memory_types.name: RAG retrieval results
memory_types.storage: Transient query result object in memory (QueryResult)
memory_types.retention: Discarded after turn completion; never persisted as new truth
memory_types.retrieval_policy: Ranked via Hybrid BM25 + dense vector; capped at top_k <= 10, max_chars <= 3500

memory_types.name: Research evidence
memory_types.storage: Deep research output brief / session artifact
memory_types.lifetime: Task duration until synthesized into report
memory_types.retention: Artifact file in app data directory
memory_types.retrieval_policy: Model inspects briefing markdown; never converts into silent permanent memory

memory_types.name: Temporary task context
memory_types.lifetime: Active mission execution until terminal state
memory_types.retention: Checkpoint status retained until mission archived
memory_types.retrieval_policy: Inspected by planner and executor during active step transitions
